title: Stardew Valley Farm Planner | Field & Farm
description: Design a farm layout on an illustrative grid, measure coverage, and export a plan.
guideText: Choose one of eight original landscape templates or import a private terrain package. Place objects, inspect water coverage and arrange linked building interiors. Export JSON to retain editable data; PNG is a visual snapshot. Built-in landscapes are not extracted game maps.

title: Stardew Valley Bundle Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track standard Community Center bundle donations, optional slots, quality requirements and room rewards.
guideText: Track full donations and quantities separately. Optional bundles need only the stated number of slots, not every candidate. Use season and room filters to plan the next collection trip. Remixed bundles remain unsupported.

title: Stardew Valley Museum Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track all 95 museum donations, acquisition routes and reward milestones.
guideText: Discovery is not donation. Use the source filter to identify missing items associated with a geode or artifact route, then mark donations after the in-game action. Reward eligibility does not confirm a reward was claimed.

title: Stardew Valley Seed Predictor | Field & Farm
description: Check prediction support and plan missing museum items by geode or artifact trove source. No verified RNG predictions.
secondaryKeywords: stardew valley does luck affect geodes
guideTitle: Plan geode collection without predicting RNG
guideText: Select a container and review matching undonated museum entries. This is a source planner, not an opening order, probability calculator or random-seed predictor. A verified version-specific adapter is required for actual prediction.

title: Stardew Valley Save Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Inspect a save locally and summarize separately recorded collection progress.
secondaryKeywords: how many steps have i taken stardew
stardew how many steps have you taken
guideTitle: Inspect a save without uploading it
guideText: The private workspace reads selected main-player XML fields and provides explicit merging for recognized crafting observations. Missing values are unknown. Manual collection records and imported observations are not a complete in-game save reconstruction.

title: Stardew Valley Crop Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Compare planting schedules, seed costs, harvest income and budget.
guideText: Set a seed budget, season and available plots; review harvest dates, crop choices and seed spending. The economy model accounts for shared inventory and daily machine collection under simplified timing assumptions. It excludes construction and labor costs.

title: Stardew Valley Fair Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Calculate grange display points from nine slots, actual sale values, quality and categories.
guideText: Enter actual sale values, quality and Fair categories. The score separates quantity, variety and item points. Compare candidate items before the fair; do not multiply the entered sale value by quality a second time.

title: Stardew Valley Fish Collection | Field & Farm
description: Track 72 fish collection entries with common acquisition conditions and season filters.
guideText: Filter by common acquisition season and search fish names or locations. Conditions are representative routes, not a complete weather or bait simulator. Record catches manually; challenge-only legendary variants are excluded.

title: Stardew Valley Perfection Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Estimate perfection from fixed weighted collection, milestone and waiver rules.
guideText: Enter the observed progress for each category. Three goals award all-or-nothing points; others award proportional credit. The private workspace can load saved manual counts, which may differ from in-game totals.

title: Stardew Valley Crafting Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 149 standard crafting recipes and aggregate materials for planned batches.
guideTitle: Prepare a batch of crafting recipes
guideText: Select recipes and batch quantities, then inspect direct ingredients, stock shortages and estimated costs. Batch outputs may contain multiple items. Intermediate recipes and profession-specific ingredient substitutions are not automatically expanded.

title: Stardew Valley Shipping Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 154 shipping collection entries and filter missing items.
guideText: Filter the 154 reference entries and mark an item only after shipping it in the game. Finding or owning an item is not the same as shipping it. Export your checklist for later use.

title: Stardew Valley Cooking Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 81 dishes, plan cooking batches and aggregate direct ingredients.
guideText: Select recipes, enter batch quantities, and compare required ingredients against current inventory. Unlock hints identify common learning routes. Unknown prices remain unknown; intermediate dishes are not recursively expanded.

title: Stardew Valley Golden Walnut Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track Golden Walnut tasks by region, collection progress and upgrade spending.
guideTitle: Track lifetime finds separately from spending
guideText: Record repeated drops individually and fixed rewards as complete tasks. The upgrade ledger subtracts purchases from recorded balance, not lifetime collection. Puzzle hints can be revealed when needed.

title: Stardew Valley Farm Comparison | Field & Farm
description: Compare eight farm types by tillable area, additional buildable tiles and characteristics.
guideTitle: Choose a farm for your priorities
guideText: Compare eight farm types by reference area and characteristics. Water, obstacles and sprinkler restrictions affect practical capacity. The original design templates are illustrative, not pixel-accurate game maps.

title: Stardew Valley Grandpa Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Calculate Grandpa evaluation points and candle thresholds from earnings, skills and milestones.
guideText: Enter lifetime earnings, skill levels, friendships and completed milestones. Four candles require at least 12 points in the reference model. Record community center completion and its ceremony separately.

title: Stardew Valley Skills Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Calculate skill levels, XP thresholds and mastery progress.
guideText: Enter skill experience and mastery points to compare against thresholds. The overnight level-up event determines actual profession rewards. Mastery points are separate from the five base skill experience values.
